verdict.rationale: A probe confirms NVIDIA serves a root llms.txt at docs.nvidia.com, described as a collection of llms.txt files for AI user agents. There are also llms.txt files for the software stack that runs on B200 (CUDA, NeMo, NIM, JAX Toolbox, AIPerf). However, the B200/DGX user guide has no markdown variant (the .md probe returned 404), and no B200- or DGX-specific llms.txt is evidenced. Missing for 10: a DGX B200-specific llms.txt or agent-oriented hardware docs, a markdown rendering of the B200 user guide, and independent corroboration of agents using these docs.
